paragraphs: Art. 1. This ordinance sets the conditions and procedure for notaries' access to the National Database (NDB) "Population" maintained by the Ministry of Regional Development and Public Works.
Art. 2. (1) Only notaries and assistant notaries entered in the register of the Notary Chamber have individual access to the data of the NDB "Population".
(2) They use the information only for official purposes within their legal powers, in compliance with the Personal Data Protection Act and this ordinance.
Art. 3. (1) The Ministry, through the Chief Directorate "Civil Registration and Administrative Services", provides the data to the persons under Art. 2(1).
(2) The following data may be provided:
1. personal number;
2. names (first, father's and family);
3. changes of names;
4. sex;
5. citizenship;
6. place of birth;
7. birth certificate (number, date and place);
8. permanent and current address (address history);
9. identity document;
10. legal restrictions;
11. marital status;
12. marriage certificate or divorce decision (number, date and place);
13. death data (date, number, date and place of the certificate);
14. personal number, names, citizenship and whether alive, of: a) the spouse; b) the mother; c) the father; d) brothers and sisters; e) children.
(3) The scope of the data provided depends on the purposes for which they are used in the official duties.

10.title: Control
paragraphs: Art. 10. (1) The access of the persons under Art. 2(1) is subject to control.
(2) The Ministry controls the access on a periodic random sample of all persons checked by the user.
Art. 11. Within one month of receiving the sample, the persons under Art. 2(1) must inform the Ministry of the ground for accessing the personal data of the persons in the sample.
